items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, do not expand alerts, enable monetization, deploy, change tracking, or send external permission outreach. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates remain blocked. Technical compliance is not certification: 34 pass, 14 fail, and 11 unknown. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix, then route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all four remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required; missing written permission, field-level provenance and rights, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal evidence, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next actions: complete the field-level rights matrix and counsel packet; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking; produce the read-only vendor, log, and incident inventory.
